featured.title: Extreme Heat Is Crushing India's Workers: Lost Wages, Broken Bodies, and a Crisis With No Safety Net
featured.excerpt: A new global report warns that heat stress could erase nearly 24 workdays per year for outdoor workers in South Asia by 2030, while India's garment factory study finds 87% of workers suffering heat-related symptoms.
featured.image_caption: Construction workers labour under the scorching sun in India. Over 90% of the country's workforce operates in the informal sector without heat-related protections or income safety nets.
featured.image_credit: Photo by Photo Frames on Pexels
featured.nri_angle: The heat crisis underscores the human cost of climate change in India, affecting the livelihoods of over 500 million informal workers who lack basic protections.

just_in.excerpt: With 2,100 GCCs employing 2.36 million people and generating nearly $100 billion in revenue, Indian states are competing to attract the next wave of multinational tech hubs to cities like Noida, Nagpur, and Lucknow.

just_in.nri_angle: The GCC boom offers NRIs career opportunities in India that increasingly match global standards in scope, with tier-2 cities emerging as viable alternatives to traditional tech hubs.

just_in.title: Alternative-Fuel Vehicles Hit Record 40% of India's Car Sales as Iran War Drives Fuel Switch
just_in.excerpt: Electric, hybrid, and CNG vehicles claimed an unprecedented share of passenger vehicle sales in June as surging petrol prices push Indian consumers toward cheaper alternatives.
just_in.image_caption: An electric vehicle charges at a station in India. Alternative-fuel vehicles including EVs, hybrids, and CNG models reached a record 40% of passenger car sales in June 2026.

just_in.nri_angle: The record shift to alternative-fuel vehicles is reshaping India's auto market, with Tata Motors and Mahindra emerging as EV leaders while the Iran war's fuel price hikes accelerate the transition for millions of Indian consumers.

just_in.title: Samsung Biologics Launches $1.8 Billion Bid for PolyPeptide, Expanding Into GLP-1 Drug Manufacturing
just_in.excerpt: South Korea's largest biopharma CDMO will acquire Swiss peptide specialist PolyPeptide in an all-cash deal that expands its manufacturing network across the US, Europe, and India.
just_in.image_caption: Samsung Biologics operates one of the world's largest biomanufacturing facilities in Incheon, South Korea. The company is expanding into peptide-based therapeutics through its $1.8 billion acquisition of PolyPeptide.
just_in.nri_angle: PolyPeptide's India manufacturing facility will become part of Samsung Biologics' global CDMO network, signalling continued foreign investment in India's pharmaceutical production capabilities.

just_in.title: Indian Students Cool on the American Dream as Europe Emerges as the New Promised Land
just_in.excerpt: Tighter US visa rules and the India-EU trade deal are driving a generational shift in where young Indians choose to study, with European enrolments climbing and consultants reporting a 25-30% surge in inquiries.
just_in.image_caption: Students attend a university lecture. The EU is actively courting Indian talent through structured visa pathways and lower tuition fees under the India-EU trade deal.

just_in.title: Agnikul Cosmos Plans India’s First Ocean Booster Recovery With Mission 02
just_in.excerpt: The Chennai-based space startup will attempt a controlled descent and ocean landing of its Agnibaan rocket’s first stage, with former ISRO chief Somanath S joining the board ahead of the flight.
just_in.image_caption: A rocket launches into the sky during a commercial space mission. Agnikul Cosmos plans to attempt India’s first ocean recovery of a rocket booster with its upcoming Mission 02.
just_in.nri_angle: India’s private space sector is producing reusable rocket technology that competes at the global frontier, a point of pride for the diaspora community working in aerospace and technology worldwide.

just_in.title: TCS Leads ₹1.54 Lakh Crore Rally as Five of India’s Top-10 Firms Gain in Market Value
just_in.excerpt: Strong Q1 earnings from India’s largest IT services company drove a ₹72,000 crore jump in its market capitalisation, powering a broader advance among blue-chip stocks despite geopolitical headwinds.
just_in.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. Five of India’s top-10 most valued companies added a combined ₹1.54 lakh crore in market capitalisation last week.
just_in.nri_angle: The market rally, driven by strong IT earnings and financial sector strength, is relevant for NRI investors with exposure to Indian equities and those tracking blue-chip companies like TCS, Reliance and ICICI Bank.

just_in.title: Accenture Splits Salary Hikes for 780,000 Employees Between Base Pay and Lump Sum
just_in.excerpt: The global IT services giant is dividing approved raises equally between a permanent base pay increase and a one-time cash payout, a shift that affects roughly 350,000 employees in India.
just_in.image_caption: Accenture’s global headquarters at Grand Canal Square in Dublin, Ireland. The company has revised its salary hike structure for its June 2026 compensation cycle, affecting more than 780,000 employees worldwide.
just_in.nri_angle: Accenture employs roughly 350,000 workers in India and is one of the largest private-sector employers of Indian IT professionals, making its compensation decisions directly relevant to diaspora families and tech workers.

just_in.excerpt: The Draft National Health Research Policy 2026 proposes raising public investment from 0.024% to 0.15% of GDP by 2047 and shifting focus from academic publications to real-world patient outcomes.
just_in.image_caption: A researcher works with test tubes in a laboratory setting. India's draft health policy proposes expanding multidisciplinary research units across medical colleges nationwide.
just_in.nri_angle: The policy could accelerate development of affordable medicines and vaccines, benefiting the global Indian diaspora that relies on India's pharmaceutical industry.

news.excerpt: Two opposing ocean anomalies are working in rare alignment to suppress Atlantic hurricane activity, but the combination could amplify extreme heat and weaken the Indian monsoon.
news.image_caption: A satellite view of a tropical ocean system. The rare emergence of an Atlantic Niña alongside a Super El Niño has created an unusual dual climate anomaly that is suppressing Atlantic hurricane activity in 2026.

news.title: Pakistan Launches Diplomatic Push to Uphold Islamabad Peace Deal as US-Iran Tensions Flare
news.excerpt: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and the collapse of the US-Iran ceasefire are testing Pakistan's dual role as mediator and military ally, with Islamabad scrambling to keep its diplomatic project alive.
